about: Crown Cut (katana.k_l4), milestone-1 task 32: Attack2H02's straight overhead, the blade raised over 10 frames and held at the top, the cut at its own speed into the active frames 13.5-15.5, a 16-frame recovery out of its low finish to the settle at 31.5, and a 0.99 m okuri-ashi step into the cut (the back foot stepping up, the front foot stepping with the cut, the back foot following).
